name: Inamori Kei
source:
A striking beauty with sharp, defined features. She always keeps a wooden sword within reach.

The kendo club, impressed by her skill, has been trying to recruit her, but she keeps turning them down.

After school, she always practices alone behind the school.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
